title: Ability
description: Something a species brings (#222): a special attack the player triggers (#221), a passive that helps the player while the companion is active, or one that helps the companion itself. A special attack is one species' own (#228) and has its own type (#626). One file per ability, named after its id.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

description.description: What it does, for the player; it may name content with text tags, like ${MONSTER:ombulumo} (#733, TextTags).

codex.description: Its codex entry (#959): what the player reads on its codex page.

entry.description: A short text about it and where its name comes from.

gloss.description: What its name means, hand-written (#959), e.g. "thud, then splash".

power.description: A special's: how much of its species' strength one strike deals, in thousandths (#33, #410): 3000 is three times it.

cooldown_seconds.description: A special's: the seconds before it can fire again (#410).

strike_type.description: A special's: its type from the type chart (#626), whatever fits it, not necessarily one of its species'.

path.description: Its path mark (#470, #471): which of the story's two paths it belongs to, none, one or both.
